testNames: real PNG and JSON specify 32 distinct explicit crops at one source-pixel scale
invalid dimensions, duplicate frame order and out-of-bounds rectangles are rejected
only first-stage normal tigers acquire the art identity, including retained death identity
ordinary tiger idle and walk independently traverse all eight frames and loop
natural contact shows all eight attack frames without changing movement, contact damage or RNG
hit uses four frames, holds the last pose and leaves the original damage/stun/movement rules intact
pause freezes tiger attack, hit and retained death clocks; resume advances them
death preserves facing/body size, presents 0..3 once, expires at .42s and clears recycled fields
Canvas draws all 32 crops in both directions without bob, rotation, squash or death stretch
renderer rejects elite/Boss/untagged identities and falls back safely when the tiger sheet is absent
viewport culling preserves visible tiger limbs and death poses beyond all four screen edges
note: Node/Canvas mock only; this verifies simulation and Canvas calls, not decoded browser pixels, GPU performance or WeChat-device behavior. Real-browser evidence is a separate gate.
